page: OVHcloud l40s-180 is a GPU-accelerated cloud server powered by an AMD EPYC 9124 processor using the x86_64 architecture. The server features 30 dedicated physical cores running at 2.75 GHz with one thread per core. It is equipped with 180.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.0 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, the system integrates two NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, delivering a combined 96 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is rated at a baseline speed of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results show top-tier performance in large language model inference. The server achieves top 10% rankings in prompt processing and text generation speeds across small, medium, and large models, including 70B parameter models. CPU-bound workloads also perform strongly, with stress-ng single-core and multi-core tests, Passmark CPU scores, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression placing in the top 25%. However, memory bandwidth for large uncached blocks and standard Geekbench processing tasks remain in the middle 50%, indicating that the server's primary performance advantage lies in GPU-accelerated compute and instruction-heavy CPU tasks rather than raw memory throughput.

From a resource density perspective, the l40s-180 offers high qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that can fully leverage its dual-GPU setup and dedicated AMD EPYC cores. The inclusion of 96 GB of total VRAM makes it highly suitable for deep learning, large language model inference, and parallel graphics processing. The dedicated core allocation and strong cryptographic and vector instruction support also make it a viable option for high-performance computing, database operations, and intensive data processing tasks where shared-resource contention must be avoided.
description: OVHcloud l40s-180 is a GPU-accelerated server designed for high-compute workloads. It features an AMD EPYC 9124 processor with 30 dedicated physical cores running at 2.75 GHz, paired with 180.0 GB of system memory and a 400 GB NVMe SSD. The server's primary acceleration comes from two NVIDIA L40S GPUs with a total of 96 GB VRAM. In benchmarks, the instance delivers top-tier performance in LLM inference across small, medium, and large models, alongside strong CPU and cryptographic execution. While large-block memory bandwidth and general Geekbench scores sit in the average tier, the dedicated hardware configuration provides excellent resource density for parallel processing. This server is highly suited for large language model inference, deep learning, and high-performance computing tasks.
